def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) 
  (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) 
  (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) 
  (n : ℕ) : P n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => h0
  | _ => 
    let m := n / 2
    if n % 2 == 0 then 
      h_even m (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd m)
    else 
      h_odd m (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd m)
